svg.aria-label: Blue: how often a device is active that hour · red: two devices, or two sessions, at once
svg.text: Blue: how often a device is active that hour · red: two devices, or two sessions, at once

g.text: Each number = % of the last 28 days on which it happened in that hour, e.g. 71 = on 20 of 28 days. Shown from 15.
